digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified CI workflow on GitHub Actions
propositions: Gerrit Verified wall-clock duration increased from 15–20 minutes to 30–40 minutes due to macOS test work growth (+14m31s pytest execution), expensive unit test mechanics (real sleeps and timeouts), and contention-amplified subprocess/filesystem work under GitHub Free org limits.

Mutation testing added at e0b3fdfc8e does not directly cause the regression; 57 of 62 post-mutation runs skipped mutation, active mutation showed 0s critical-path addition, and skipped runs averaged 36.5m versus 33.0m for active runs.

Specific expensive test mechanics identified include 120s Jira missing-field timeout, five 5s sleeps in capability probe, 25s dependency audit retry, 15s backoff/timeout tests, repeated AST parsing in four guards, and per-worker wiki corpus cache recomputation.

macOS execution median 27.0m and queue median 0.72m across 62 post-mutation runs; org queueing contention and subprocess/APFS nonlinearity under load amplify deterministic test work, not editor startup.

Root cause is combination of ~4.1k additional tests added (+775.69s pytest growth), real-time test mechanics, and process contention; remediation is decomposed into seven linked tickets addressing fake clocks, injected delays, AST caching, wiki corpus caching, and timeout windows without altering coverage or runner topology.
Existing --durations=25 telemetry proved sufficient for RCA; no observability code change required.
